book.name: 1 Timotius
book.title: 1 Timotius Paulus susura masososa na fee nonoon Timotius

content: Masodaꞌ naraa no lahenda fo doꞌo-tabe neuꞌ Manetualain

Masososa na, au hule emi fo hule-haradoi fee basa lahenda ra. Emi meu mataa Manetualain, sona hule fo Ana tulu-fali basa lahenda fo rai susa-lela daleꞌ. Ma hule makasi, huu fo Ana tao malole neuꞌ sira basa.

Hule-haradoi leo naꞌ boe, fee maneꞌ ara ma basa lahenda mana homu pareta. No ria na, ita basa tasoda no tesatei-tamadaleꞌ, ma mole-dame tuka Manetualain hihii-nanaun. Masodaꞌ ria, naraa no lahenda fo doꞌo-tabe neuꞌ Ana.
Huhule-haradoi rupa leo naꞌ a tao laꞌe na Manetualain Manasoi-manatefa dale Na.
Ana nau soi-tefa na lahenda masala-masikoꞌ, ela ara hapu soda-moleꞌ manabasa taꞌa, ma bubuluꞌ hihii-nanauꞌ bea rina matetuꞌ. Leo iaꞌ:

content.text: Ma noi lelete esaꞌ a neni fee ita lahenda dae-bafoꞌ a mole-dame to Manetualain. Lelete ria riꞌ Yesus Kristus.
Ana fee heni hihiiꞌ ao-paa Na, ela soi-tefa na ita basa teme sala-sikoꞌ ara mai, de ta hapu huhukuꞌ soꞌ.

content: Naraa no ledo-fai na, Manetualain soi Tutui Malole ria neuꞌ loa na, fo nafada basa lahenda ra.

Boe ma Ana here na au, fo dadi Ria lahenda nadedenun, ela au u afada lahenda fo ta Yahudi fa nai basa mamanaꞌ ara. Ma anori si ela ramahere neuꞌ Ramatua Yesus ma rasoda tuka eno roo-tetuꞌ a. Hata fo au afadan a, nana tebe leoꞌ na. Au ta dedea fufudiꞌ fa.

Au hihii-nanauk leo iaꞌ: nai mamanaꞌ bea-bea oo, maneniko emi mabua fo hule-haradoi, sona emi dale mara muste malole esa no esa. Bosoꞌ mamananasa aoꞌ. Bosoꞌ mareresiꞌ. Maneniko emi soꞌu lima mara fo hule-haradoi, sona emi dale mara muste malalao-malalafuꞌ dei.

Leoꞌ na boe, soa neuꞌ inaꞌ ara. Au nau sira kao-pake no hadaꞌ, ela naraa nai lahenda matan. Bosoꞌ kao-pake seli uukuꞌ ralane rupa lakadoo nara, pake bua-loas mabeli, pake lilo-henu, ma mutiara fo tao fee lahenda mete rasuu tinoꞌ asa. Hata fo tao na inaꞌ ara napuꞌ mesan, nana riꞌ, malalao-malalafuꞌ, ma hada-pari malole. Ria riꞌ naraa soaneuꞌ inaꞌ fo doꞌo-tabe neuꞌ Manetualain.
Maneniko lahenda kamahereꞌ ara rabua ela ramanene nanoriꞌ, sona inaꞌ ara tuka atoran fo nenene ratalolole nanoriꞌ ria. Bosoꞌ rabobotoꞌ ma tao isuoteꞌ.
Tuka au, sona inaꞌ ara ta naraa soꞌu-fua ao nara fo pareta touꞌ ara ma ranori si. Malole lenaꞌ inaꞌ ara neneeꞌ.
Huu fo Manetualain adu naꞌuluꞌ Adam. Basa ria besaꞌ ko Hawa.
Ma nitu ra malaka na ta edi-fule nauluꞌ Adam, tehuu inaꞌ a dei. Mulai neme fai ria mai, lahenda dae-bafoꞌ a nalenalaka no Manetualain atoran na.
Huu fo leo mae leoꞌ na boe, inaꞌ ara bisa hapu sodaꞌ a, nana huu ara boki-lae. Sadi ara ramahere tebe-tebe neuꞌ Kristus, rasue-ralai ao, ma rasoda no dale makamoi, no matetu.

footnotes.text: Lahenda fo ralelaꞌ laꞌeneuꞌ Susura Makamoiꞌ a, ara rae hapu dale dodooꞌ laꞌeneuꞌ “inaꞌ ara bisa hapu sodaꞌ, nana huu ara boki-lae”. Riꞌ: 1) hapu Anaꞌ esa, riꞌ Yesus. Ana soi enoꞌ ela basa lahenda ra bisa hapu sodaꞌ; 2) Ruma bali rae, Hawa riꞌ hapu eedi-fufuleꞌ ma tao salaꞌ, tehuu ria boe dadi besaꞌ fee basa lahenda ra; 3) ruma rae, inaꞌ fo masoda na naraa ana ta mate tepoꞌ fo ana boki (tehuu lahenda malelaꞌ dodouꞌ rae dale dodooꞌ ia ta naraa).
